classification.summary: GrimBoostVault.depositFor(token, amount, user) took the deposit token as a caller-supplied parameter and minted shares around an unguarded external transferFrom call, so the attacker passed its own contract as the token and re-entered depositFor from that callback, minting eight tranches of vault shares against a single SpiritSwap BTC/WFTM LP deposit before burning them all in withdrawAll to drain the vault.

sources.note: Onchain review over plain JSON-RPC. Etherscan v2 does not serve Fantom, so the victim's creation was resolved with no explorer at all, by binary-searching eth_getCode against the archive endpoint https://rpc.fantom.network (https://rpc.ftm.tools is dead and the l2beat Fantom key is disabled): GrimBoostVault 0x660184CE8AF80e0B1e5A1172A16168b15f4136bF first has code at block 15934352 (deployTimestamp 1630366055 = 2021-08-30T23:27:35Z), creation tx 0x163c49f8dcfc3c3242f6ff30b64445497b808c46e2f2c0e85c433314b678d9e0 recovered from eth_getBlockReceipts (receipt.contractAddress, direct deploy), creator 0xaa4273346d21a935bdf1302418d9531342d8142c. That creator is neither the attack-tx sender 0xdefc385d7038f391eb0063c2f7c238cfb55b206c nor the attack contract 0xb08ccb39741d746dd1818641900f182448eb5e41, so the victim is not attacker-deployed. Last change: over [15934352, 25345003] the victim emitted zero EIP-1967 Upgraded, zero BeaconUpgraded, zero Compound-fork NewImplementation(address,address), zero DiamondCut and zero AdminChanged events; its EIP-1967 implementation slot 0x3608...2bbc and beacon slot 0xa3f0...3d50 both read zero, so there is no implementation pointer to binary-search and the contract is a plain 8488-byte non-proxy vault. A full topic sweep of every log the vault ever emitted in that range returns only ERC20 Transfer (848x) plus a single OwnershipTransferred in the creation block, so deployment is the correct basis. Incident: attack tx in block 25345003, timestamp 1639849155 = 2021-12-18T17:39:15Z, status 1, 53 logs. Decoded from the receipt: a 937830 WFTM + 30 BTC flash loan from the Beethoven X vault 0x20dd72Ed959b6147912C2e529F0a0C651c33c9ce (fee 281.349 WFTM), the proceeds added as SpiritSwap BTC/WFTM LP 0x279b2c897737a50405ED2091694F225D83F2D3bA, then eight mint Transfers out of the vault to the attack contract (0.0324, 0.1147, 0.4065, 1.4406, 5.1049, 18.0894, 64.1009 and 227.1455 shares - the seven reentrant depositFor calls plus the final real LP deposit) and one burn of the 316.4350 total. The $30m loss is rekt.news' aggregate for the Grim vaults drained that day; this row anchors on the GrimBoostVault transaction rekt.news cites and DeFiHackLabs reproduces (src/test/2021-12/Grim_exp.sol, forked at block 25345002).
